toc.title: De obitu illustrissimae principis ac dominae, D. Mariae, Friderici III, Com. Palat. ad Rhenum, Ducis Bavariae, S.R.I. Archidapiferi & VIIviri, carissimae coniugis, natae ex illustrissima Marchionum Brandemburgensium &c. familia, carmen scriptum a Lamberto Ludolfo Pithopaeo Dauentriense.
G. P. H. Christiano lectori S.
Maria morti propinqua maritum mœstum consolatur.

book: A single Latin funeral poem (carmen) of 1569 by Lambertus Ludolphus Pithopaeus on the death of Maria, Countess Palatine, preceded by a preface to the Christian reader and printed as one continuous poem with no numbered divisions.
